supersedes: r12/control_set.json human-verification blocker only; sealed R12 file is unchanged

tier1_design.basis: Fresh cell-content classifier: Unicode word sequences, numeric/presence/list cells, descriptor and native-attribute roles, chemical identifiers and explanatory prose. Inspect all row/column intersections, not caption gates or first-N-header rules.
tier1_design.shared_inputs: Frozen concept-role registry is a shared semantic specification, not independent vocabulary evidence. No old matching function or extraction helper is imported by Tier 1.
tier1_design.scope: All 400 table identities registered in the sealed R12 funnel, including original typed positives.
tier1_design.ambiguous_labels: Keep complete shape sets. For the required 7x7 display choose greatest supporting cell count, breaking ties by lexical label. Report multilabel disagreements and explicitly mark projection loss.
tier1_design.no_tuning: Freeze implementation before computing original-versus-reference agreement; no fitting or outcome-driven rule adjustment.
tier1_design.group_bridge: Only after classification, invoke the unchanged group-extraction function separately on original table content. A zero here can be an extraction limitation; do not insert captions or invent child terms. No output is admitted to frozen supervision.

tier2_design.implementation: measure_pdf_geometry_r12b.py; no classifier imports, caption or header rules
tier2_design.geometry_config: Text strategy on both axes; min_words_vertical=3, min_words_horizontal=1. At least three rows, two columns, four numeric cells and two distinct sensory cell terms. Fixed before calibration, no tuning.
tier2_design.scope: The frozen 83 no-machine-table plus 19 structure-mismatch candidates, restricted to held license-clear documents.
tier2_design.calibration: Pages covering the 40 original typed tables and an equal number of verified no-table pages from the same documents; original labels are reference measurements, not ground truth.
tier2_design.rendering: Original held PDFs may be rendered without fetching. Reflowed XML/HTML is a derivative with potentially missing figures, not an original publisher-page surrogate; disclose modality and coverage.

uncertainty.enumeration: Exact agreement on the finite enumerated table set has no table-sampling error; this does not eliminate measurement error or document dependence.
uncertainty.measurement: Without independently established sensitivity and specificity, valid accuracy identification bounds remain [0,1]. Do not invent narrow confidence intervals from agreement alone.
uncertainty.derived_groups: Report exact existing-extractor counterfactual counts separately from valid-supervision bounds [0, observed counterfactual count]. This is not an upper bound on all missed groups, including groups missed by both methods.
uncertainty.population: No inverse-recall extrapolation outside these 248 candidates.

escalation: Only disagreements go to a third independent modality. Visual escalation is optional under the owner's follow-up and is not a blocker; without a pinned local adjudicator these cases remain unresolved, never automatically tie-broken.
